Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Fixed a layout bug affecting anyone with Dalamud's Global Font Scale set to anything other than 100% - the DJ Deck and Host Lobby panel could end up sized incorrectly, with content getting cut off or needing to scroll, and the Host Lobby drifting away from the main window. Both now stay correctly sized no matter what that setting is. Also fixed the DJ Deck occasionally showing an unwanted scrollbar for some display/font setups.
